title: When Can I Do Push-Ups After Breast Augmentation?
meta_description: When Can I Do Push-Ups After Breast Augmentation? Learn safe timelines, push-up modifications, and expert tips for protecting your implants after surgery.
excerpt: No source gives a single date. One article on the ASPS website says upper-body movement waits at least six weeks, and your surgeon has the final say. Here is why they wait, how to restart from wall push-ups to standard, and what the evidence does and doesn't show about implants long term.
quick_answer:
When can I do push-ups after breast augmentation?

Wait at least about six weeks, and restart only once your surgeon clears you. No source gives a single push-up date. An article on the ASPS website says to avoid strenuous and upper-body movement for at least six weeks; another says patients can resume all exercises at six weeks, and advises avoiding push-ups, especially with implants under the muscle.
